title: A proper conversation
body: We ask what your business does, who does what, and where the day gets stuck. No sales deck. The first call is free and often enough to tell whether we are the right fit.

title: A written plan
body: You get a scope document with the modules, screens, timeline and payment stages. If something is out of scope, it says so. We would rather define the edges now than argue later.

title: Built in the open
body: Work moves in phases with a working demo at the end of each one. Your feedback shapes the next phase. Staff see the software before go-live, not on the morning it replaces their register.

title: Launch, train, stay
body: We handle migration, training and launch, then stay reachable. Most clients keep us on for support and small improvements. That long relationship is the part we care about most.
